subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC kickoff — proposed times + success criteria

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time last week. We'd like to get the POC kickoff on the calendar so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and owners. Proposed 60–90 minute kickoff agenda:
- Intros & roles (AE/SE/customer owners)
- POC scope and success criteria
- Timeline & milestones (data access, env setup, first runs)
- Dependencies (procurement, security/compliance checks)
- Next steps & owners

Proposed windows (we can do remote):
- Wed 11 Mar: 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Thu 12 Mar: 1:00–2:30 PM PT
- Fri 13 Mar: 9:00–10:30 AM PT

Please let us know which of the above works for your team and whether we should loop in procurement or security contacts. I've attached a short POC plan and a doc with suggested success criteria.

Attachments: ACME_POC_plan_v1.pdf
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-POC-plan

If none of those times work, share a couple of slots and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Procurement <bob.procurement@acme.com>, Carla Security <carla.security@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — proposed times + success criteria

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear agenda. Quick notes:
- Procurement (cc'd) needs to review any estimated spend for the POC before we lock in a date; Bob, can you share constraints?
- Security (cc'd) will want the SOC2 summary and a brief network diagram ahead of the kickoff. Carla, are there any other artifacts you need?

Of the proposed times, Thu 12 Mar 1:00–2:30 PM PT looks best for the engineers on our side. If you can't do that, we can also do Fri 13 Mar 9:00–10:30 AM PT.

Also please include Logan and Ethan on the kickoff — Ethan specifically should walk through the integration and data access steps.

Alice Jenkins
Senior Engineering Manager | Acme Corp
alice.jenkins@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Bob Procurement <bob.procurement@acme.com>, Carla Security <carla.security@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 13:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — proposed times + success criteria

Perfect — thanks Alice. Thu 12 Mar 1:00–2:30 PM PT works for us. I've tentatively held that slot and will send an invite once we confirm procurement's OK.

Carla: attaching our SOC2 summary for your review (SOC2_summary.pdf). If you'd like a short pre-kickoff rundown with Ethan on architecture/networking, we can schedule 30 minutes that morning.

Bob: any procurement timing/approval we should expect before Thu afternoon? If there's a doc template or PO flow we should follow, let me know — happy to coordinate.

Ethan & Logan: can you confirm you're good to lead the technical walkthrough and list any pre-reqs you need from Acme (S3 access, sample payloads, IP allowlist)?

Owners and draft success criteria (for kickoff discussion):
- AE: Marissa Cole (POC owner, timeline & commercial)
- SE: Ethan Park (integration, demo, acceptance tests)
- Customer Eng Lead: Alice Jenkins (acceptance & test data)
- Security reviewer: Carla Security (security sign-off)
- Procurement lead: Bob Procurement (procurement & SOW)

Success criteria (draft):
1) End-to-end demo running against customer sample data within 2 weeks of kickoff
2) Latency below 300ms median for core queries under representative load
3) Basic cost profile estimate for steady-state usage
4) Security checklist completed (SOC2 / network allowlist)

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, ACME_POC_plan_v1.pdf

Thanks — I'll follow up once procurement confirms and then send the calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>, Carla Security <carla.security@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff — proposed times + success criteria

Marissa / Logan —

I'm confirmed for Thu 12 Mar 1:00–2:30 PM PT. Quick tech checklist for the kickoff (I'll present the first half):
- Access: S3 read creds for a small sample dataset OR temporary signed URL(s)
- Network: IPs to allowlist for our test cluster (I can provide CIDR block)
- Accounts: who will be monitoring logs on your side (name/email)
- Acceptance tests: I'll bring a simple set of 5 test prompts we can run during the session to validate latency and correctness

If security wants a short pre-call, I'm available Thu 12 Mar 11:00–11:30 AM PT to run through architecture.

-Ethan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acme.com>, Bob Procurement <bob.procurement@acme.com>, Carla Security <carla.security@acme.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Acme POC kickoff — confirmed (Thu 12 Mar 1:00–2:30 PM PT)

Thanks all — booking confirmed. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-poc-kickoff

Summary / owners / pre-reads:
- When: Thu 12 Mar, 1:00–2:30 PM PT (90 minutes)
- Where: Google Meet link in invite
- Owners: AE: Marissa (POC lead), SE: Ethan (technical lead), Customer Eng: Alice (acceptance), Security: Carla, Procurement: Bob
- Pre-reads attached: ACME_POC_plan_v1.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf
- Pre-kickoff action items:
  1) Acme: share S3 sample access or signed URLs by Thu 12 Mar 9:00 AM PT (Alice / Eng team)
  2) Acme Security: confirm if a 11:00 AM pre-call is needed (Carla)
  3) Procurement: any PO/SOW template or cost approval needed before kickoff (Bob)
  4) Redwood SE: provide CIDR blocks and simple test prompts by Wed EOD (Ethan)

Success criteria (finalized at kickoff):
- E2E demo with sample data in 2 weeks
- Median latency < 300ms on core queries
- Security checklist reviewed
- Procurement next steps defined (SOW/PO)

Attachments: ACME_POC_plan_v1.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

Looking forward — let me know if anything needs changing before I send the invite to the extended team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
